title: Declined approval
description: A Company's final refusal of an approval that passed its checks: it performs nothing and returns no new operation. Operations extension 6 (Declining an approval). At an API, and at the extension's endpoint, the body of an HTTP 403 with error approval_declined. In an MCP tool error result's structuredContent, with error approval_declined. In a Company message's extensions.operations.declined, without error. reason and alternative are content from the Company (spec 10.1), and there are no reason codes. Unknown members are allowed.

reason.description: Why, in short plain language for the User. Nothing the Session couldn't already see.
